title: Citi and DBS Mark 1st Singapore-to-US Weekend Dollar Transaction
snippet: Citi and DBS made the first successful Singapore-to-U.S. dollar payment conducted on a weekend, according to a Sunday (Sept. 6) press release. The Saturday (Sept. 5) transaction was executed using tokenized deposits via the Swift Digital Ledger, the release said.
